name: How-To-Use-Innoc2Scam-Bench
description:
Innoc2Scam Bench Usage Guide
	

This repository documents how to work with the anonymous-author-32423/Innoc2Scam-bench dataset hosted on Hugging Face (https://huggingface.co/datasets/anonymous-author-32423/Innoc2Scam-bench). Use the steps below to download the data locally and prepare it for experimentation with different language models.

	
		
	
	
		Prerequisites
	


Python 3.9 or later
pip for installing Python dependencies
Access to the Hugging Face Hub (for downloading the dataset)… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/anonymous-author-32423/How-To-Use-Innoc2Scam-Bench.
reputation: A small, community-hosted Hugging Face dataset and usage guide with limited adoption outside niche researchers.
